bio.text: Garlin Gilchrist II is Michigan's lieutenant governor and the Democratic nominee for secretary of state in the November 2026 election, chosen at the party's convention on April 19, 2026.
According to his official state biography, he is a software engineer by training and lives in Detroit with his wife and children.

sources.title: Michigan Democrats choose Lt. Gov. Gilchrist as secretary of state nominee, Eli Savit for AG
